first_time.title: Come early for the lesson
first_time.text: Tuesday and Cache Bar nights start with instruction for beginners, so get there at the start time. Fairgrounds and Mountain Valley Athletics nights go until midnight.

first_time.title: No partner? No problem
first_time.text: Come solo or bring the whole crew. Plenty of people show up on their own.

first_time.title: Wear something you can move in
first_time.text: Boots are fun but not required. Pick shoes that are easy to dance in.
